accessNotes: The five official program pages were rechecked on 2026-08-10. Their client-rendered pricing widget still shipped the same 8 products, 54 tiers and identical 116,834-character pricingTableData payload (SHA-256 prefix 287134D2B306FC2D), so every recorded tier price, target and drawdown was cross-confirmed across all five pages. A later CLI retry encountered Cloudflare, while the public renderer and same-day successful payload read remained available; no checkout was attempted. ALL PRICES RECORDED ARE LIST PRICES: current promos remain HOT20 (20% off, excluding Instant Lite, expires 1 September 2026) and NEW30 (30% off 2 Phase Pro, expires 31 December 2026), and neither coupon is blended into priceUsd. Product-scoped official FAQs resolve payout/minimum-day rules for 2 Phase Pro, Instant Funding Standard, Instant Funding Lite and Lightning, and resolve overnight/copy-trading rules. INDIA SCREEN: India is absent from the current restricted-jurisdiction list repeated on FXIFY pages. Official support pages publish SumSub ID/address/selfie checks, Rise KYC for withdrawals, a $50 minimum and usual processing within 3 business days; no completed Indian checkout, KYC approval or payout was independently tested.
